content: Dockerfile Python slim best practices: (1) Copy requirements.txt first, then pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt, then copy source — this caches the pip layer across code-only changes. (2) python:3.11-slim is 121MB vs 875MB full image. (3) Set PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 and PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1. (4) WORKDIR /app is standard. (5) For src/ layout without pyproject.toml [project] section, use ENV PYTHONPATH=/app/src — avoids pip install and is simpler than adding build backend config.
